stage: Final validation of this structured-state research phase; no automatic follow-on experiment

primary.weighting: Equal weight per input, frozen fit, noncontrol query and output component
primary.comparison: No-effect prediction of the original output; not task accuracy, claim reliability or semantic interpretation

uncertainty.method: Paired percentile bootstrap, resample inputs within each seed block after averaging the five frozen fits
uncertainty.interpretation: Approximate test-input uncertainty conditional on the five fits and fixed queries; not a population-of-models guarantee

decision: Close this phase either way. Support limited utility only when the pooled one-sided 95% upper relative-RMS estimate is at most 0.8 AND each seed-block point estimate is at most 0.8. Apply the same rule at 0.1 for close prediction. Report nonfinite cases as failures. Do not retune after seeing this holdout.
secondary: Report all original orders, both prescribed radii, both models/cuts, horizons and sizes. The small-edit full-quadratic result and large-edit failure remain descriptive; neither can replace the primary after data inspection.
costs: The unchanged common evaluator constructs all orders from 73 probes per input/cut/horizon/radius. It is not an optimized 13-probe linear runtime. Construction time is descriptive, not a speed benchmark. It retains the measured 1720-byte full rule; a stand-alone linear base/J would need 280 bytes, which is an algebraic count, not a measured memory saving.
scope: Raw known-field response prediction only. No training of neural weights, changes to old ranges/thresholds, codec repair, discovered semantics, natural-language inference, GPU-memory saving or execution authentication. Full raw reports stay on the DGX; the upload bundle includes per-input losses, original input arrays, report hashes, gates, costs and all summary cells.
